summary: Completed API regression and browser smoke testing. Auth, protected resources, sanitization, dashboard, search, student creation, timetable/assignment/announcement/report navigation, and mobile sidebar open all passed. Attendance UI has a data-shape/integration defect.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/attendance returns only existing attendance records, while the page uses that response as the full roster. With one marked record, the UI renders one row as Unknown and hides the other seeded students.

action_items: Fix attendance roster integration: return/join all students for the selected date, or have the frontend load students separately and merge date-specific attendance.
Add/verify a distinct student dashboard or enforce role-specific navigation if that requirement remains in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Attendance endpoint is not date-aware and does not provide a complete roster, causing the core attendance workflow to degrade after any record exists.
Student users receive the same staff-oriented dashboard/navigation; role-based access is enforced for writes but not reflected in the student experience.
seed_data_creation: Created and removed one TEST_ student; marked one attendance record for that temporary student during API regression. Existing attendance state was not otherwise modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth cookie persistence, admin/student login roles, invalid credentials, logout API, all listed GET endpoints, sanitization, dashboard, student search/add, page navigation, and mobile menu open passed. Re-test attendance from a clean attendance dataset and verify all students render with selected-date statuses.
rca of the issue: The backend attendance handler returns db.attendance rows only and adds student_name only for rows present in that collection. The React Attendance component treats a non-empty response as the complete class list, so any existing record suppresses its fallback rows; missing student joins become Unknown. Mitigate by joining attendance with students server-side or fetching students and merging statuses by student_id/date.
